issue.description: Add conformance coverage for merging stale checkpoint input after historical events have been redacted or rewritten. issue.description:
ADR-005's drawbacks record this incompleteness directly: 'There is currently no way to mark an assignment as intentionally held', so a bead deliberately parked under an assignee is indistinguishable at the schema level from worker residue, and operators will learn to ignore the ready_frontier warning. Work: design and implement an explicit reservation marker (e.g. a held/parked flag with its own audit event and checkpoint round trip) that exempts an assigned open issue from the ready_frontier diagnostic. Keep the marker opt-in and advisory-safe, document it in the schema/field-guide surface, and cover it with lifecycle and concurrency tests.
